findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Batu itu butuh berabad-abad untuk belajar berhit" → 3 lines (13 words, 38.4px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 6 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div#glowbg → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(150, 110, 255, 0.16), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.jstick → radial-gradient(at 66% 50%, rgba(120, 90, 220, 0.12), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header#bar 1440px | li 592px | li 592px | li 592px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The margins differ: 48px on the left, 100px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Semua berawal dari angka" (screen 2, 100% over a picture); "Titik-titik mencari garis" (screen 3, 100% over a picture); "Ketidakpastian punya bentuk" (screen 4, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: Little motion: 8 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 2 of 10 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 9, 10.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Segera hadir" above "Fisika untuk AI"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Batu itu butuh berabad-abad untuk belajar berhit" → 3 lines (13 words, 25.6px, a paragraph set above 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 107 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Daftar", "pelajaran", "Tutup", "Esc"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
